metadata.title: Ball growth at all scales in universal covers of short metric graphs
metadata.abstract: Let $\Gamma$ be a connected metric graph of first Betti number $b\ge 2$, and let $\Gamma_b$ be a trivalent graph of the same Betti number with all edges of unit length. We show that if $\text{length}(\Gamma) \le \lambda\, \text{length}(\Gamma_b)$, then the universal cover of $\Gamma$ contains a vertex around which, \emph{at every radius} $R\ge 0$, the ball is at least as long as the ball of radius $R$ in the trivalent tree whose edges all have length $3\lambda$. In particular, for $\lambda\le\frac13$, this ball is at least as long as the ball of the same radius in the universal cover of $\Gamma_b$, with no multiplicative loss. This improves an earlier theorem of the author, which gives the weaker lower bound $(1-3\lambda)$ times the ball in the universal cover of $\Gamma_b$, and only for $\lambda\le\frac16$. The proof rests on an elementary comparison principle. Among trees whose vertices have degree at least three and whose edges have length at most $c$, the trivalent tree with all edges of length $c$ has the smallest balls at every radius. As an application, we double the exponential growth rate in the author's earlier uniform lower bound for the area of balls in the universal cover of small-area surfaces of hyperbolic type, from $\ln 2$ to $2\ln 2$, beyond the hyperbolic rate. We also obtain explicit constants in the positive answer to Guth's question for surfaces. Finally, we conjecture the sharp, all-scale version of the minimal volume entropy inequality of Kapovich--Nagnibeda and Lim, and show that it would be optimal.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 证明短度量图的万有覆盖中存在同一顶点，使以它为中心的球在每个半径都不小于指定等边三价树的球；当长度比 λ≤1/3 时可直接比较单位边三价模型而无乘法损失，并改进小面积曲面覆盖中的指数面积增长下界。
analysis.breakthrough: 把旧的带损失估计提升为全尺度的同一中心比较，并将曲面应用中的增长指数加倍。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。文末关于最优全尺度最小体积熵的不等式仍为猜想，不能与已经证明的树比较混同。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
